body.intent: Fix Ship-change stops on a rebase conflict and waits for the owner instead of resolving it: run 01M6W0Z45JXE (change set 01M6VY7G6HPJ, Workflow dispatch, PR #367) stopped at wait-pr on 2026-11-08 ~01:20Z with 'rebasing cs/workflow-dispatch onto origin/main conflicts in describe-golden.txtar, internal/api/change.go, internal/api/run.go, internal/changeset/body.go, body_test.go, internal/daemon/requests.go, internal/store/read_test.go; the rebase was aborted; answer question rebase-conflict-workflow-dispatch'. With several runs in flight, main always moves under a long run, so this will recur. Instead, ship-change should merge origin/main into the branch (never rebase or force-push) and give the conflicts to a fixer agent session with both sides' commits and change sets as context. The fixer resolves them, regenerates golden files, runs the touched packages' tests, commits with trailers and pushes; the run records the push and goes on. It asks the owner (or the arbiter in an autonomous run) only if the fixer reports a real design clash. Unstuck by hand: an agent merged main in the run's worktree, answered the question and resumed the run.
